name: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
description: An in-ring show featuring more wrestlers, more stories and more action to super-serve fans.

videos.title: Best of 2023
videos.overview: AEW Collision is making a special appearance for international fans on TrillerTV, but with a twist. Instead of its regular scheduled broadcast on the night of AEW Worlds End, it will be a ‘best of 2023’ special episode airing at 8 pm GMT the following night.

videos.title: Countdown to Double or Nothing 2025
videos.overview: Preview the Anarchy in the Arena at AEW Double or Nothing where the Death Riders and Young Bucks will collide with Kenny Omega, Swerve Strickland, The Opps and Willow Nightingale. Plus, the Owen Hart Foundation Tournament Men's Final will conclude with Will Ospreay vs. "Hangman" Adam Page.

videos.title: Countdown to All In 2025
videos.overview: Preview of AEW All In: Texas on Saturday, July 12th. Jon Moxley collides with "Hangman" Adam Page for the AEW World Championship in a Texas Death Match. Mercedes Moné challenges "Timeless" Toni Storm for the Women's World Title. The epic rivalry continues as Okada battles Omega for the Unified Championship.

videos.title: Countdown to Forbidden Door 2025
videos.overview: Preview Sunday's FORBIDDEN DOOR with a review of a crazy week of action!

videos.title: Countdown to AEW All Out: Toronto 2025
videos.overview: A look at the upcoming AEW All Out: Toronto event on Saturday, September 20, available for purchase on HBO Max. Christian Cage and "Rated R Superstar" Adam Copeland continue their tag-team reunion as they fight FTR. World Champion "Hangman" Adam Page vs. challenger Kyle Fletcher. Jon Moxley faces Darby Allin in a Coffin match. "Timeless" Toni Storm must defend her title in four-way battle.

videos.title: Countdown to WrestleDream 2025
videos.overview: Jon Moxley and Darby Allin prepare for anything in a no-holds-barred "I Quit" match. Now that Samoa Joe has stepped up to challenge "Hangman" Adam Page, will this be the end of his world championship reign? It's the first-ever one-on-one battle between new women's champion Kris Statlander and the woman she dethroned, Toni Storm.

videos.title: Countdown to Full Gear 2025
videos.overview: Preview of Saturday's FULL GEAR where Hangman Adam Page will defend the AEW World Championship against Samoa Joe in a Steel Cage. Mercedes Moné will challenge Kris Statlander for the women's title. The Casino Gauntlet match returns to determine the inaugural AEW National Champion.

videos.title: Countdown to Worlds End 2025
videos.overview: A look at the wrestlers challenging AEW World Champion Samoa Joe for his title at the WORLDS END PPV on Saturday, December 27, from the NOW Arena in Chicago. Plus, who will be the ultimate winner in the Continental Classic tournament?

videos.title: Countdown to Revolution 2026
videos.overview: A preview of the upcoming All Elite Wrestling: Revolution pay-per-view event in Los Angeles on Sunday, March 15. World Champion MJF meets Hangman Adam Page in a Last Chance Texas Deathmatch. AEW World Tag Team Champions FTR will face the three-time champions Young Bucks. Kris Statlander challenges Thekla in a two-out-of-three falls match for the AEW Women's World Championship.

videos.title: Countdown to Dynasty 2026 - April 11, 2026
videos.overview: Preview of Sunday's AEW Dynasty. "The Devil" faces "The God of Pro-Wrestling" as MJF defends the All Elite Wrestling World Title against a relentless Kenny Omega. Will Ospreay seeks violent revenge on Jon Moxley, the man who nearly ended his career. The legendary duo of Adam Copeland and Christian Cage reunite on a mission to dethrone FTR for tag team gold.

videos.title: June 17, 2023
